name: Lumini
description:
New Zealand government policy change. See it early. Understand it clearly. Act while it matters.

Focused exclusively on Aotearoa New Zealand, Lumini is a government and public policy platform built on two foundations:
1. A comprehensive, continuously updated collection of New Zealand government, parliamentary, legislative and regulatory information.
2. Practical tools that help organisations discover and monitor developments, investigate issues, understand their implications, prepare effective responses and pursue policy, legislative and regulatory settings that better reflect their needs.

The read-only Lumini MCP connection provides authorised users access to our source-linked New Zealand government and policy dataset, specialist monitoring, and policy and advocacy workflows directly within Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Lumini to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Lumini to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.getlumini.co/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Lumini MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lumini provides these MCP tools: get_consultation_deadlines, get_legislation_summary, get_minister_report, get_my_context, get_usage_stats, get_weekly_top_10, search_committee_hearings, and search_documents.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Lumini?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Lumini in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Lumini requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Lumini is developed by Lumini. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
